sections.abstract: Sjögren's syndrome (pSS) is an autoimmune disorder affecting mainly the exocrine glands.this lead to dryness of the main mucosal surface ,such as the mouth ,eye,skin nose,pharynx,larynx and vagina . The history of the disease is characterized by a slowly progression of sicca symptoms and fatigue; however, a subset of patients would experience extra glandular activity.
